paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Engineering Materials and Technology

machine_learning_models.name: ANN-Neuber artificial neural network model
machine_learning_models.task: prediction of temperature-, strain-rate- and orientation-dependent Ramberg-Osgood parameters and approximate local stress-strain response at notch
inputs: elastic stresses from purely elastic finite element analysis
machine_learning_models.target: Ramberg-Osgood parameters defining relation between principal stresses and strains
machine_learning_models.dataset: TIVP simulations under plane stress conditions
machine_learning_models.validation: graphical comparison against natural spline interpolation to check overfitting; comparison with TIVP model predictions

evidence.quote: The trained ANN shows good correlation with the CVP model predictions at arbitrary temperatures, strain rates, and orientations, since these effects are captured in the Ramberg-Osgood parameters.
information for the highest stressed element concerning tempera- ture, orientation, and strain rate may be passed into the ANN model to give the approximate Ramberg-Osgood curve for that element.
